agent.accept.freightMarket: On the marketplace now — a nearby truck will be offered this load.
agent.accept.freightReceiptNote: Write this on the customer’s receipt — it is how they follow the shipment.
agent.accept.freightCollect: Collect up to {amount} in cash now — give change once the driver’s price is set.
agent.accept.gapBoth: to load it here and unload it at the destination
agent.accept.gapThere: to unload it at the destination
agent.accept.gapDetail: This load may need a forklift or tail-lift {where}. Arrange it before the truck arrives.
agent.accept.mapLabel: Map of {count, plural, one {# shop} other {# shops}}
agent.accept.noShops: No shops on the network to send toward yet.
agent.accept.budgetLabel: Cash budget — the most the customer will pay
agent.accept.budgetNote: No driver can be paid more than this. Collect it in cash now; give change once the price is set.
agent.accept.earlyClaim: Let a driver reserve it before the day — useful when trucks are scarce
agent.accept.indivisible: This cannot be split into smaller loads
agent.accept.indivisibleNote: One piece that has to travel whole — a machine, a tank, a beam. It changes what kind of truck is needed, and measuring cannot tell us.
agent.accept.excludedBodies: Is there any truck the customer will not accept?
agent.accept.excludedBodiesNote: Only if they say so — most customers do not mind. Drivers on these trucks will still see the load and will be told it is the customer’s choice, but they cannot take it.
agent.accept.derivedBodyGuess: We will look for {body}, worked out from the weight alone
agent.accept.negotiate: Let drivers name their own price
agent.accept.negotiateNote: Instead of the first suitable truck taking it at our rate, drivers send you a price and you pick one. Slower, and usually cheaper for an awkward load. The cash budget still applies.
agent.offers.title: Space on runs already going
agent.offers.lede: Carriers put their spare space on here. The price is theirs and fixed — no bidding, no waiting for an answer.
agent.offers.none: Nothing on offer right now. Post your load above and carriers will price it.
agent.offers.terms: If you keep them waiting: {minutes} min free, then {rate} {currency} an hour.
agent.offers.noTerms: No charge if they have to wait for you.
agent.offers.m3Hint: Worth measuring for anything bulky. A pallet of foam weighs nothing and fills half a truck — and on this run you would be charged for the space, not the weight.
agent.offers.bindsSpace: This fills more space than it weighs, so the space is what it takes on the run.
agent.offers.needWhat: Say what you are sending — the carrier is loading it.
agent.mine.title: Space you have taken
agent.mine.notYours: The booking this notice is about is not among this shop’s bookings.
agent.mine.lede: Every run you have booked onto, including the ones that are over. Nothing is tidied away — what you sent last month is still the answer to what you sent last month.
agent.mine.findTruck: Your goods were not collected — you will need another truck.
agent.mine.otherRunsOne: One other run on this route is open for booking.
agent.mine.otherRunsMany: {n} other runs on this route are open for booking.
agent.mine.routeClosed: Other trucks on this route meet the same closure — check before you book another run on it.
agent.mine.givenBackRebook: Book again with what you are actually sending.
agent.mine.givenBackTruck: Your goods will not travel on this run — you will need another truck.
agent.mine.noReason: They gave no reason. Your goods were not collected — you will need another truck.
agent.mine.track: Tracking link — send it to whoever is receiving the goods
agent.mine.claimLede: This goes to {company} with your consignment note and the photographs either side of the journey. SeeBuyGet records it and does not decide it — we never held this payment and we carry no cover on these goods.
agent.mine.claimWhatPh: Two of the twelve crates were crushed on the near side.
agent.mine.claimAmountHint: Optional, and your figure — we do not verify it and we do not pay it.
agent.mine.claimNeedWords: Say what went wrong — the carrier is answering this.
agent.mine.claimSentDetail: They will answer it. Nothing is decided by us.
agent.mine.claimWaiting: The carrier has not answered yet.
agent.mine.claimBetween: Settle it between you — SeeBuyGet neither decides nor pays.
agent.mine.claimClosed: The seven days to raise a claim on this load have passed.
agent.mine.gaveBackDetail: It is on offer again for somebody else.
agent.freight.title: Freight you posted
agent.freight.notYours: The load this notice is about is not among this shop’s loads.
agent.freight.ownerReads: This shop’s loads are read by its owner. Ask them to open it.
agent.freight.lede: The loads this shop sent out, and the prices drivers have offered.
agent.freight.emptyLede: Loads you book at the counter for a truck will appear here.
agent.home.jobFreightSub: Loads you sent out, and the prices drivers offered
agent.freight.homeCardCount: {n, plural, one {# price} other {# prices}} to answer
agent.freight.pricesEmpty: No driver has named a price yet.
agent.freight.priceRun: {empty} km empty to reach you, {loaded} km loaded
agent.freight.overBudget: Above the budget — raise it with the customer first
agent.freight.countered: You answered {amount}: waiting for the driver
agent.freight.counterSent: Your price is with the driver
agent.freight.confirmBody: The load {code} goes to this driver at {amount}. That settles it — the price is agreed and the job is theirs. You pay them {amount} in cash from the customer’s budget when they collect it; SeeBuyGet pays nothing for this load.
agent.freight.confirmRun: They run {empty} km empty to reach you, then {loaded} km loaded
agent.freight.acceptedToast: Price accepted — the load is theirs
agent.freight.cancelBody: {code} comes off the market. A driver who had claimed it is told, and a charge you paid comes back. Once the goods are on a truck this is no longer possible.
agent.freight.cancelReasonLabel: Why? It goes on the consignment note.
agent.freight.cancelledDetail: It is off the market. A driver who had claimed it has been told.
agent.freight.attemptUnreachable: the driver could not reach the place
agent.freight.attemptAdvice: The driver still has the goods. Ring the receiver, or message the driver about where to take them.
agent.freight.refusedRow: Refused at the door: say where the goods go by {by}.
agent.freight.handBackAdvice: The load is on the market again and any charge has come back. Nothing has moved.
agent.freight.claimOpen: Report a problem with the goods
agent.freight.ratedLine: You rated this delivery {stars} out of 5.
agent.freight.trackBody: Send this to whoever is waiting for the goods. It shows where the load is, who is carrying it and who signed for it — nothing else. The same code is printed on the consignment note.
agent.freight.trackShareText: Your load {code} to {dest} — see where it is:
agent.freight.trackCopied: Copied. Paste it into a message.
agent.freight.instructBody: What the driver needs at the door. Until the goods are taken over you can rewrite this; after that you can only add to it.
agent.freight.instructAddBody: The goods are on the road, so this is added to what the driver was already told, with the time — the note keeps both.
agent.freight.instructAddLabel: What should the driver do now?
agent.freight.instructedDetail: They are on the consignment note. A driver holding the load has been told.
agent.freight.rateBody: Your verdict on {driver} for this delivery. It counts toward their rating like every other shop’s, and you can change it within 30 days.
agent.freight.rateIssuesHint: Tags rather than words, so what you say can be counted with what other shops say.
agent.freight.ratedDetail: It counts toward the driver’s rating from now.
agent.freight.claimTitle: Report a problem with the goods
agent.freight.claimBody: {code} was delivered. Say what you found. SeeBuyGet does not judge a claim or pay one: your claim goes onto the consignment note, frozen as the damage claim report, for you to hand to the carrier or your insurer. Only where the company that billed the load has stated cover does a member of staff decide it, up to that cover.
agent.freight.claimShort: Short — some of it is missing
agent.freight.claimPhotoAria: Take a photo of the problem
agent.freight.claimToastDetail: An operator decides it. You will be shown their reason here.
agent.freight.claimOpenLine: Claim ({kind}) sent {when} — waiting for a decision
agent.freight.claimReportLine: Claim ({kind}) sent {when} — the damage claim report was made: the consignment note under Notes, frozen with your claim on it. Nobody of the network decides it; hand the note on by a link.
agent.accept.customerPhoneNote: If they have a phone they can follow the shipment. If not, the printed code is enough.
agent.accept.consignee: Who receives it at the other shop (optional)
agent.accept.consigneeNote: Printed on the consignment note as the consignee.
agent.accept.dangerousNote: From the goods’ safety data sheet: the consignment note prints them, and the driver needs them.
agent.accept.instructionsPh: e.g. Call Joseph on arrival. Gate on the north side.
agent.accept.incoterm: Trade term agreed with the buyer (optional)
agent.accept.incotermHint: Only the terms this country has switched on can be used. Leave it alone if the customer did not agree one — the sender claims for damage, as before.
agent.freight.termReceiverClaims: Risk passed at the origin, so the receiver claims for damage on the road, not you.
agent.freight.termSenderClaims: You carry the risk to delivery, so you claim for damage on the road.
agent.accept.instructionsNote: Goes on the consignment note (box 13) and to the driver who takes the load. Not for the price — that is agreed on the load itself.
agent.counter.title: Hand over a parcel
agent.counter.lede: Ask the customer for their code.
agent.counter.unknownCode: That is not a code we recognise. An order code looks like COL-3F9A2B71; a code for a parcel someone sent is four digits.
agent.counter.aloudCode: Ask the customer for their code and scan or type it here.
agent.counter.waitingBody: The network reminds a customer once. After that it is you: say when you close, or that it has been here a while.
agent.counter.waitingNone: Nothing is waiting on the shelf.
agent.counter.peerBody: A four-digit code cannot tell us which parcel it is — it is the second check, not the search. Scan the parcel the customer is asking for and the code will be checked against it.
agent.collect.checkContents: Let the buyer check the contents
agent.collect.noItems: No item list came with this order.
agent.collect.aloudFound: Fetch the parcel from shelf {slot}. Let the buyer check it, then hand it over.
agent.collect.aloudPrompt: Ask the buyer for their collection code and type it in.
agent.handover.title: Hand to the bus
agent.handover.lede: Scan the driver’s pass to see this bus’s list, then scan each parcel as it goes on.
agent.handover.badgePh: Scan the badge on the driver’s phone
agent.handover.passFirst: Scan the driver’s pass: the list of what this bus takes from your shop comes up here.
agent.handover.scanLabel: Scan each parcel as it goes on
agent.handover.nothingForBus: Nothing is waiting here for this bus.
agent.handover.notThisBus: {id} is not for this bus: it goes to {zone}
agent.handover.notThisBusDetail: Keep it at the shop for the bus that goes there.
agent.handover.notWaitingHere: {id} is not waiting at this shop
agent.handover.scanHint: Scan the sticker on each parcel as it goes on. A green beep: on the list. A red one: keep it here.
agent.handover.missedOne: {count} parcel for this bus still waiting
agent.handover.missedMany: {count} parcels for this bus still waiting
agent.handover.missedDetail: Scan the ones marked “Waiting” onto the bus too, or leave them behind.
agent.handover.leaveSheetOne: {count} parcel will stay at your shop and the office will be told. Why is it not going?
agent.handover.leaveSheetMany: {count} parcels will stay at your shop and the office will be told. Why are they not going?
agent.handover.reasonNoSpace: No space left on the bus
agent.release.onBusTitle: It is still marked as on the bus
agent.release.onBusBody: If the driver just dropped it here, mark it arrived and put it on the shelf. The customer already has their pickup code — the sender gave it to them.
agent.release.markArrived: Mark arrived — put it on the shelf
agent.release.enterCode: Enter the code the customer shows you
agent.release.hereTitle: Taken in here: photograph the hand-over
agent.release.hereDetail: This parcel was taken in at this shop, so the code was seen here. A photo of the hand-over is the receiver’s proof that it was collected.
agent.release.rateBody: Ask the customer to rate this delivery.
agent.release.starHint0: Tap a number — 5 is the best.
agent.release.noCode1: It is in the SeeBuyGet app of the person it is for, under My parcels
agent.release.noCode2: A person who sent it has it too; a store’s buyer has it from the store
agent.release.noCode3: Never hand over without the code
agent.release.aloudScan: Scan the parcel label or sticker to begin.
agent.release.aloudOtp: Ask the customer for their four digit code, type it in, then confirm.
agent.release.aloudArrive: Mark the parcel arrived to send the customer their code.
agent.release.aloudRate: Ask the customer to rate the delivery from one to five.
agent.receivebag.title: Receive a bag
agent.receivebag.lede: Scan the code on the bag the driver handed you. Before it is opened: read its seal, photograph it, and say whether it is as it was closed.
agent.receivebag.step1: Every parcel inside goes onto your shelf
agent.receivebag.step2: Each customer gets their pickup code
agent.receivebag.step3: The empty bag goes back with the next bus
agent.receivebag.putAwayTitle: Put each parcel in its slot
agent.receivebag.putAwayLede: Each customer is sent to the slot named here. You can find a slot again under Hand out.
agent.receivebag.aloud: Scan the bag code. Read the number on its seal, photograph it, and say whether it is as it was closed. Then every parcel inside is shelved and the customers get their pickup codes.
agent.tamper.title: Packaging cut or opened
agent.tamper.lede: A slit tape, a box opened, a torn wrap: before the parcel goes anywhere, scan it, photograph it as it is and report it. It is held here and SeeBuyGet operations is told.
agent.tamper.scanPlaceholder: Scan its sticker or its barcode
agent.tamper.photo: Photograph it as it is, before anything is touched
agent.tamper.who: SeeBuyGet operations and the store that sent it are told at once. Kept with the parcel’s record, with your photograph.
agent.tamper.doneWait: Set it apart and do not open it further. It goes into no bag and to nobody until operations releases it; then it goes on as usual.
agent.tamper.aloud: A parcel cut or opened: scan it, photograph it as it is, and report it. It is held here until operations releases it.
agent.toast.bagHeldDetail: SeeBuyGet operations is told. Keep it closed: it is received once they release it.
agent.toast.tamperReportedDetail: SeeBuyGet operations is told. Keep it apart until they release it.
agent.toast.tamperQueued: No signal — kept on this phone
agent.toast.tamperQueuedDetail: It goes with its photograph the moment there is a signal. Keep the parcel apart meanwhile.
agent.void.title: Undo a drop-off
agent.void.lede: Took one in by mistake? You have five minutes to undo it and get your money back.
agent.void.nothingCard: Nothing to undo. Only a parcel you took in within the last five minutes can be undone.
agent.void.aloudOne: {count} drop-off can still be undone. Tap one, photograph the torn label, and confirm.
agent.void.aloudMany: {count} drop-offs can still be undone. Tap one, photograph the torn label, and confirm.
agent.void.aloudNone: Nothing to undo. Only a parcel taken in within the last five minutes can be undone.
agent.void.closedDetail: This one can no longer be undone. Ask the control tower.
agent.void.tearLabel: Tear the label off the parcel and photograph it — that is the proof it cannot be used again.
agent.void.check1: Your wallet is refunded straight away
agent.void.check2: The parcel is cancelled for good
agent.rates.title: Prices near you
agent.rates.lede: What nearby shops charge to handle one parcel.
agent.rates.noneYet: No nearby shop has published a price yet.
agent.rates.benchmarkYou: You charge {price} — you are setting the benchmark.
agent.rates.scaleLabel: Prices go from {min} to {max}. You charge {mine}.
agent.rates.aloudNone: No nearby prices yet. You are setting the benchmark.
agent.consignments.title: Consolidation lots
agent.consignments.lede: Pool members’ durable goods into a truckload. When a lot fills, it books a freight truck on its own.
agent.consignments.empty: No lots yet. Open one above to start pooling deposits.
agent.consignments.pickupPh: e.g. the co-op store at Aleta Wondo
agent.consignments.pickupMapLabel: Where the truck loads — tap the map to place it
agent.consignments.mapLabel: Where the truckload goes — tap the map to place it
agent.consignments.pinned: Pinned. The truck is paid for the distance to this point.
agent.consignments.geoExact: Found {where}. The truck is paid for the distance to this point.
agent.consignments.geoApprox: Found {where}, roughly. Move the pin if it is not right.
agent.consignments.geoGuess: That name is not on our map — this is a best guess. Tap the map to place it yourself.
agent.consignments.noPin: Type the name and tap “Find it on the map”, or tap the map to place it yourself.
agent.consignments.capNote: The cash cap is the most the co-op will pay a driver to move the full load. Members’ deposits and payout are settled off the app.
agent.consignments.postedDetail: This lot is on the freight marketplace — a truck will pick it up.
agent.consignments.receiverNote: Printed on the load’s consignment note, with your co-op as the sender. Give a name with an address, or the name alone where the place says it.
